240-5470-7272-7297.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
240-5470-7272-7297.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Reaper of Flight Moonsilver ability, giving Reaper of Flight Moonsilver +2/+1 until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

225-2577-7084-8095.easyPrerequisites:
You control another Zombie.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
225-2577-7084-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping the land.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

1445-2279-4871-6495.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-2279-4871-6495.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Quintorius triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.
1445-2279-4871-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

728-1445-1913-4871.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and an artifact creature card in your graveyard.
728-1445-1913-4871.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Imotekh the Stormlord triggers if the creature that was returned to your hand was an artifact, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing a creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1308-3129-4365-6664-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and The Wandering Minstrel.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

1669-5621-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Arid Archway.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Thaumatog by sacrificing Arid Archway.
When Arid Archway dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Arid Archway from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Arid Archway enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Thaumatog ability
Repeat.

215-1376-6791.notablePrerequisites: There are at least four Elves on the battlefield.
215-1376-6791.description:
Activate Priest of Titania by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Priest of Titania from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Priest of Titania by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5256-6972-7754--167.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the other Mutant.
When the Mutant dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the Mutant enters, X-23 triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on X-23 and the other Mutant.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.
5256-6972-7754--167.notes: The chosen Mutant must have toughness 2 or greater.

618-4456-7494-7729.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, copying Blazing Firesinger. It'll enter prepared due to its effect.
Cast a copy of Seething Song by paying {2}{R}.
The Vision and Scarlet Witch triggers as well as Hematite Talisman.
Resolve the Vision and Scarlet Witch trigger, adding {R} and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Hematite Talisman trigger, causing you to pay {3} to untap Kiki-Jiki.
Resolve Seething Song, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

2744-4613-5446-7150.notablePrerequisites: You control two additional creatures, one of which must have a +1/+1 counter on it and hasn't used Kirol's ability this turn.
2744-4613-5446-7150.description:
Cast Esika's Chariot by paying {3}{G}.
When Esika's Chariot enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate a creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it using Kirol's ability by tapping two creatures you control, copying Esika's Chariot's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Esika's Chariot's trigger, creating two 2/2 Cat creature tokens.
When the Cats enter, Cathars' Crusade triggers twice, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control
Repeat from step 3, using one of the Cats to activate Kirol's ability, and then tapping both Cats.

618-5062.description:
Activate the mutated Porcuparrot and Kiki-Jiki creature by tapping it, creating a token copy of it with haste.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any additional creature without summoning sickness you control

requires.n: Permanent with Landfall Ability: Create Creature Token(s)

765-872-3259--85--106.notablePrerequisites: An opponent is unable to block and kill creatures you control.
765-872-3259--85--106.description:
Activate Scaled Herbalist by tapping it, putting Guildless Commons from your hand onto the battlefield.
Guildless Commons enters the battlefield, triggering itself and the permanent with a landfall ability.
Resolve the Guildless Commons trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the landfall trigger, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage to an opponent with the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to and then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token from step 4, untap all creatures you control, and get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

5147-6887-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
5147-6887-7084.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, The Skullspore Nexus and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the The Skullspore Nexus trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

4053-4742-5499--6.notablePrerequisites: The creature with undying does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
4053-4742-5499--6.description:
Activate the creature with undying by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {3}.
When the creature dies, Solemnity triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {3}, attaching it to the undying creature.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control except Donatello

3259-7291-7292.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control an artifact creature.
3259-7291-7292.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Donatello and the creature that has Breath of Fury attached, triggering Donatello and Breath of Fury.
Resolve the Donatello trigger, creating a token copy of the artifact creature.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the artifact creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase

2173-4905-5220-5708.description:
Activate Fanatical Firebrand by tapping and sacrificing it.
When Fanatical Firebrand dies, Mortuary and Vein Ripper trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Fanatical Firebrand from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Vein Ripper trigger, causing you to gain 2 life and target opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Fanatical Firebrand ability.
Cast Fanatical Firebrand from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

225-539-573-6628.description:
Activate PuPu UFO by tapping it, putting Gruul Turf from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Gruul Turf enters, it and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping PuPu UFO as it is a land due to Ashaya.
Repeat.

261-5670-6792--5.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
261-5670-6792--5.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Suture Priest triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
When the Treasure enters, Mm'menon triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature.
Repeat.

372-695-2974.notablePrerequisites: You have a number of nonland permanents exiled by Abdel Adrian that enter the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least the mana cost of Settle Beyond Reality.
372-695-2974.description:
Cast Settle Beyond Reality by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves and re-enters the battlefield, causing all cards exiled with it to be returned to the battlefield. Abdel Adrian and Repository Skaab's exploit ability trigger.
Resolve the Repository Skaab trigger, exploiting another creature and triggering its second ability.
Holding priority, activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least the cost of Settle Beyond Reality.
Resolve the Repository Skaab trigger, returning Settle Beyond Reality from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling the mana producing permanent(s) and Repository Skaab and creating that many 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
Repeat.

2034-3372-6006-6791.manaNeeded: {1}{W} if Enduring Vitality is not a creature
2034-3372-6006-6791.description:
If Enduring Vitality is not a creature, activate Zur by paying {1}{W}, causing Enduring Vitality to become a creature.
Activate Enduring Vitality by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar's second ability by sacrificing Enduring Vitality, adding {C}{C}.
When Enduring Vitality dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as an enchantment.
Repeat.

1947-3139-3327-4613.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
1947-3139-3327-4613.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}.
When Dargo enters the battlefield, The Great Henge triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Dargo and causing you to draw a card.
Activate Dargo using Reckless Barbarian's ability by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
Choose to return Dargo from your graveyard to the command zone.
Repeat.

2104-4863-6122.notablePrerequisites: {1}{U} available plus enough mana to cast Temporal Manipulation and Revolutionist each turn.
2104-4863-6122.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Revolutionist by paying its mana cost.
When Revolutionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Dour Port-Mage by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, returning Revolutionist from the battlefield to your hand.
Dour Port-Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

1170-1636-2733.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {U}{U}.
1170-1636-2733.description:
Activate any number of creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {U}{U}.
Cast Shimmering Wings by paying its mana cost, targeting any creature you control except Displacer Kitten.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking itself.
When Displacer Kitten enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Shimmering Wings spell.
Activate Shimmering Wings by paying {U}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1721-3210-4659.notablePrerequisites:
You control any number of mana-producing artifact(s) that enter the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {R}{R}.
You control at least three additional nontoken artifacts, including the mana-producing artifact(s).
1721-3210-4659.description:
Activate any number of mana-producing artifacts you control by tapping them, adding at least {R}{R}.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing any artifact except itself, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 2 for each remaining applicable artifact.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing itself, adding {C}{C}.
Cast Scrap Mastery by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing each player to exile all artifact cards from your graveyard, then sacrifice all artifacts they control, then return all exiled cards from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat steps 1-4 one additional time.
Activate Codex Shredder's second ability by paying {5}, tapping and sacrificing it, returning Scrap Mastery from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 5.
If artifacts you control can tap to produce at least {1}{R}{R}, this combo nets infinite mana of those types.
If you control four or more other nontoken artifacts as this combo begins, this combo nets infinite colorless mana.

914-4790.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least six artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-4790.description:
Activate Dino DNA's second ability by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Dockside Extortionist that is a 6/6 Dinosaur.
When the Dockside Extortionist token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least six Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate six Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {6}.
Repeat.
If opponents control at least seven artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens and colored mana.

2438-4690-4871-5003.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three basic lands.
2438-4690-4871-5003.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Phylath.
When Phylath dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Phylath from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Phylath enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, creating at least three 0/1 Plant creature tokens.
Activate Carrion Feeder three times by sacrificing three Plants.
When the Plants die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers three times, creating three Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder abilities from steps 1 and 7, putting four +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}.
Repeat.
If you control at least four basic lands, this combo nets infinite Plant tokens, Treasure tokens and colored mana.

176-2034-5003.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional nontoken non-Spirit creature.
176-2034-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a nontoken non-Spirit creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Requiem Angel and Nim Deathmantle triggers.
Resolve the Requiem Angel trigger, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Spirit, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger from step 2, causing you to pay {4} to return the non-Spirit creature from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.

764-3840-3858.notablePrerequisites:
Your commander on the battlefield.
Colossus Hammer attached to your commander.
764-3840-3858.description: At the beginning of your upkeep, Mayael's Aria triggers, causing you to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control, gain ten life and win the game.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

1283-1987-4423-5243.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Chromatic Orrery by tapping them, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Chromatic Orrery.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

1534-3407.manaNeeded: {U}{U}{R}, plus an additional {R} if Dual Strike was not foretold, plus enough mana to cast the additional spell if needed
1534-3407.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cast an additional instant or sorcery, or an opponent is casting one.
1534-3407.description:
Cast any other instant and/or sorcery spell, or wait for an opponent to cast one.
Holding priority, cast Dual Strike by paying {R}{R}, copying the next instant or sorcery spell you cast with mana value four or less.
Cast Twincast by paying {U}{U}, targeting the instant or sorcery spell cast in step 1.
Dual Strike triggers, copying Twincast, with the copy targeting the original Twincast.
Resolve the copy of Twincast, copying Twincast, with the copy targeting the original Twincast.
Repeat step 5.
